certification_boundary: Rev0368 supports a public-pension private-market fee/liquidity/valuation and contrary-performance perimeter. It does not certify the case until plan-level legal priority, cash flow, net-of-fee returns, capital calls, manager fees/carry, valuation policy, liquidity limits, and service/tax/worker incidence are bound.
proved_surfaces: need for actuarial/plan-level evidence rather than aggregate asset comfort
alternative-asset growth and reported fee/expense salience
private-equity/private-debt illiquidity, capital-call, valuation, disclosure, and contribution-volatility risk
industry-side contrary claim of strong private-equity net-of-fee returns
next_primary_records: plan ACFR/CAFR, actuarial valuation, and GASB schedules
private equity/private debt commitment, unfunded commitment, capital call, distribution, NAV, and secondary-sale records
management fee, carried-interest, performance-fee, consultant, and fund-expense schedules
valuation policy and independent valuation/audit records
cash-flow/liquidity stress under benefit payments and capital calls
legal protection/priority map for retirees, workers, bondholders, taxpayers, service users, and manager fee claims
local service/tax/wage/tier incidence under contribution shocks
net-of-fee and risk-adjusted return comparison with survivorship, vintage, and selection controls
